_meta.WARNING: is_motion is PLAY-level: the offense used motion, not that THIS player was in motion. This is a team-scheme split measured on a player's targets, NOT a player-level motion split. Player-level motion and routes-run are paywalled (PFF / Fantasy Points Data).
_meta.denominator: targets, not routes — route participation is unavailable publicly
